title: SQL Injection in login form
description: The username field is concatenated directly into the SQL query string instead of using parameterized queries, allowing authentication bypass with a payload like ' OR '1'='1' --

title: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) on profile endpoint
description: Any authenticated user can view another user's profile by changing the numeric ID in the URL, with no ownership or authorization check on the server side.

title: Session tokens are predictable
description: Session identifiers appear to increment predictably rather than being cryptographically random, potentially allowing session hijacking.

title: Verbose server banner disclosed
description: The server response header discloses the exact Flask/Werkzeug version, which could help an attacker identify known vulnerabilities for that version.
